about: Persona camera and scene presets. Pick one from each group to build a shot. Each preset adds a short phrase to the image prompt. The character's identity sentence always comes first, so the face stays the same while the shot changes.

groups.name: Lighting
groups.hint: Time of day and light quality

camera.name: 35mm full body
camera.prompt: full-body shot on a 35mm lens at eye level, head to shoes in frame

camera.name: 50mm three-quarter
camera.prompt: three-quarter length shot on a 50mm lens, from mid-thigh up, eye level

camera.name: 85mm portrait
camera.prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait on an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, eyes in sharp focus

camera.name: 24mm wide scene
camera.prompt: wide 24mm shot, the character full length and small in a large scene, environment visible

camera.name: Low angle hero
camera.prompt: low-angle full-body shot looking slightly up, 35mm lens, strong confident framing

camera.name: Overhead
camera.prompt: shot from directly above, full body visible, graphic composition

camera.name: Across the street
camera.prompt: candid telephoto shot from across the street, 135mm lens, full outfit visible, passers-by soft in the foreground

camera.name: Mirror selfie
camera.prompt: mirror selfie, phone held at chest height, full length reflection, slight wide-angle phone look

camera.name: Detail close-up
camera.prompt: macro close-up of one accessory or shoe, the outfit soft behind it, 100mm lens

camera.name: Film snapshot
camera.prompt: point-and-shoot film snapshot with direct flash, 28mm, slightly off-centre, full outfit visible

lighting.name: Golden hour
lighting.prompt: warm golden-hour sunlight from the side, long soft shadows

lighting.name: Soft overcast
lighting.prompt: soft even overcast daylight, true-to-life colours

lighting.name: Window light
lighting.prompt: soft natural window light from one side, gentle falloff

lighting.name: Clean studio
lighting.prompt: clean studio lighting, large softbox, seamless backdrop

lighting.name: Night flash
lighting.prompt: night-time on-camera flash, dark background, crisp highlights

lighting.name: Neon night
lighting.prompt: city neon light, coloured reflections, cinematic night mood

lighting.name: Blue hour
lighting.prompt: cool blue-hour dusk light with warm practical lights in the background

lighting.name: Hard noon sun
lighting.prompt: bright midday sun, hard graphic shadows, high contrast

location.name: City street
location.prompt: on a busy city sidewalk with shopfronts

location.name: Café
location.prompt: at a small corner café table by the window

location.name: Apartment
location.prompt: in a minimal, lived-in apartment with plants and books

location.name: Coloured wall
location.prompt: against a single bold painted wall

location.name: Beach
location.prompt: on a quiet beach with soft sand and sea in the background

location.name: Park
location.prompt: in a leafy city park on a path

location.name: Rooftop
location.prompt: on a rooftop with the city skyline behind

location.name: Subway
location.prompt: on a subway platform, train lights blurred

location.name: Market
location.prompt: walking through an outdoor flower or food market

location.name: Gallery
location.prompt: in a white-walled art gallery with large artworks

pose.name: Walking
pose.prompt: walking toward the camera mid-stride, natural movement

pose.name: Standing relaxed
pose.prompt: standing relaxed, weight on one leg, hands in pockets

pose.name: Sitting
pose.prompt: sitting casually, legs crossed, outfit still fully visible

pose.name: Leaning
pose.prompt: leaning against a wall, looking off to the side

pose.name: Looking back
pose.prompt: looking back over the shoulder toward the camera

pose.name: Doing their hobby
pose.prompt: absorbed in {hobby}, not looking at the camera

pose.name: Adjusting outfit
pose.prompt: adjusting a jacket collar or sleeve, hands near the clothes

add: no text, no watermark, no logos
avoid: a real person's face or name
changing the face, hair colour or signature detail

settings.midjourney: --ar 2:3 --style raw, add --cref with your main reference image and --cw 100
settings.other_tools: Portrait 2:3 or 4:5, at least 1200 px on the long side. Always attach the reference images if the tool allows it.

variety_rules.about: The drift guard warns when the same set-up repeats, because repeating one recipe is what makes a feed look samey (model collapse).

models.name: ChatGPT images (GPT Image)
good_for: clean images with no stray text

models.name: Gemini image (Nano Banana)
good_for: keeping the same face from reference photos
quick edits of an existing image

models.name: Stable Diffusion + your LoRA
good_for: cheapest at volume once a LoRA of the character is trained

models_note: Credits are Persona's rough relative cost per image (1 = cheapest), not exact prices. Real prices change; check each tool.
